selected_priority: Remove the production CandidateProfile bottleneck by compiling Helix-loadable, provenance-bound candidate profiles directly from real private resume evidence instead of relying on hand-authored static JSON.
displaced_capability: The target-application runtime already required an exact CandidateProfile, while the private application workspace held strong resume evidence but no maintained executable bridge from those resumes into the Helix profile contract. That manual gap prevented the strongest P1 application path from being reproducibly initialized.

mechanisms_compared.assessment: Continue hand-authoring CandidateProfile JSON from resume text. Rejected because it preserves a drift-prone manual bridge with weak provenance.
Use permissive resume parsing or generative extraction to infer profile claims. Rejected because ambiguous or invented claims could silently enter recruiter-facing application state.

Selected: conservative source-text parsing plus multi-resume evidence composition, exact SHA-256 provenance, conflict rejection, atomic output, and validation through the existing Helix load_candidate_profile contract.

capabilities: compile one or more Markdown resumes into the existing Helix CandidateProfile JSON contract
preserve the first resume as the primary identity, headline, and summary voice while composing deduplicated specialized evidence
extract structured skills from Core Competencies and Technical Skills tables
extract Key Projects evidence into experience and measurable project bullets into achievements
reject conflicting candidate identities and conflicting contact evidence instead of silently merging them
reject resumes missing Summary, structured skill evidence, or Key Projects evidence
hash every resume source with SHA-256 and attach source provenance plus a source_text_only_no_claim_invention policy
write output atomically and validate the completed artifact through load_candidate_profile before success
preserve existing manual CandidateProfile loading and all downstream target-application interfaces

preserved_gains: existing CandidateProfile schema and load_candidate_profile behavior remain unchanged
target_application_cycle and application_operations interfaces remain unchanged
Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, and SmartRecruiters discovery paths remain unchanged
Opening Watch materiality, packet freshness, and stale-lineage rollback behavior remain unchanged
private resume sources are read-only inputs and are never rewritten by the compiler
no external application submission or recruiter communication was introduced

checks: strict Ruff over production compiler and adversarial tests
single-resume compilation into a load_candidate_profile-compatible artifact
multi-resume evidence union with deduplication and primary-voice preservation

Execute the first real stranded repository-family restoration through manifestless exact-SHA federated restoration and prove recovered behavior in that repository native runtime.
